newsitem.title: FINLAND: ASKO DISPOSES TAMPERE WATER POWER PLANT.
newsitem.headline: ASKO DISPOSES TAMPERE WATER POWER PLANT.

text.p: Finnish plastic pipe and furniture manufacturer Asko Oy said in a statement on Wednesday it had sold its water power plant and its Finlayson electricity grid to the City of Tampere for 56.3 million markka.
"The deal is part of a strategy as a result of which Asko focusses on its core business operations," it said.
Petri Olkinuora, managing director of Asko's Tampereen Kiinteisto Invest Oy told Reuters by telephone that Asko will book a profit on the deal, but he declined to elaborate.
"There will be a profit from the deal," he said.
Asko's January-August results are due on October 10.
